of the ship.

お？
あんた、噂の男だな。
よし、あたしと一発ヤるか？<EN>Oh? You're that rumored guy. Alright, want to go
a round with me?

ちょっと！
なんて会話してんですか！？<EN>Hey! What kind of conversation is that!?

そっちのちんちくりんより楽しませてやるぞ～？<EN>I'll make sure you have more fun than that
little shrimp over there~?

だーれがちんちくりんですかこら！
あやまれ！　あやまれ！<EN>Who's the little shrimp, huh?!
Apologize! Apologize!

あんたのことは冒険者ギルドでも噂になってる。
狙ってる奴は少なくねーぞ、気をつけな。<EN>You're even talked about in the Adventurer's
Guild. There are quite a few guys after you, so
watch out.
